about.text: An enzyme that milk carries to defend itself: with hydrogen peroxide it oxidises thiocyanate into compounds that stop bacteria. It is isolated from whey, like lactoferrin, and used in toothpaste, mouthrinse and cosmetics, and in a Codex method to keep raw milk in warm countries.

facts.v: Raw milk eventually runs out of hydrogen peroxide; adding peroxide and thiocyanate re-activates the enzyme
